Delhi Court Cancels Non-Bailable Arrest Warrants Against SFI Leader

A Delhi court quashed non-bailable arrest warrants issued to SFI leader Aishe Ghosh in connection with the 2021 JNU violence case. The court's decision was made on [date] after a petition from Ghosh's lawyer. Ghosh is a key participant in the youth movement against the government's policies. The police had claimed that Ghosh was involved in the violence, but the court rejected this claim. Ghosh's lawyer alleged that the police were trying to intimidate her client. The court's decision has been welcomed by activists and opposition parties.
